messages:
Irene - DevEx: Quick flag: detected several sampleapps (node/python/go) where auth-retry rebuilds requests and drops propagation headers (x-request-id/traceparent). We should pick a cross-lang policy.

Vik - SDK: Agree. Two-pronged: sampleapps fix and an SDK safety lint/test. For SDK, propose an advisory lint that warns when a retry path constructs a new request without copying headers/propagators.

Sam - SampleApps: Repros seen in Node (manual opts w/o headers), Python (new Request without headers), Go (NewRequest without Header clone). I've got small PRs queued for each.

Elena - Infra: Also worried about tenant-level redact regexes masking IDs in logs. We should update docs to discourage greedy patterns like ".*id.*".

Vik - SDK: Draft of the lint rule (concept): in JS/TS, detect calls to fetch/new Request in retry helpers and ensure header spread or request.clone is used. In Go, catch NewRequest used inside RoundTripper wrappers without Header.Clone. In Python, detect prepare_request from scratch in retry path. The lint should be advisory initially.

Irene - DevEx: Nice. Can we also add a tiny runtime check in http instrumentation: if active span/context exists and outgoing request lacks propagation headers, emit WARN once per process and increment metric sdk.propagation.missing. That catches non-linted code in the wild.

Vik - SDK: Yes, opt-out via env var. I'll open rwd.in/issue/1701 for lint + rwd.in/issue/1702 for runtime warn+metric.

Sam - SampleApps: I'll fold a sample test into sampleapps CI that exercises 401->refresh and asserts the outbound request log contains x-request-id. Link in PRs.

Elena - Infra: Infra will add an integration test to staging that triggers the flow end-to-end and fails if trace continuity broken. Also updating redact regex docs.

AuditBot: Policy note: add to "DX onboarding" checklist: "ensure retries preserve propagation headers or use SDK helper".

Irene - DevEx: Ok top-level plan: 1) sampleapp PRs merge, 2) SDK lint advisory, 3) SDK runtime warn+metric, 4) infra integration test, 5) docs update. I'll track in project board and close thread when PRs are merged. Thanks :thumbsup:
